summary: Verified the Pin & Scrub Hero bug fix (App.css: .sc-app overflow-x: clip). At viewport 1440x900, .sc-hero-sticky.getBoundingClientRect().top === 0 at scrollY 0, 500, 1000, 1500, 2000, and 2500 — confirming CSS position:sticky now works and the Hero is pinned throughout the scrub range. Video (data-testid=hero-video, duration 8.042s) currentTime increases proportionally with scroll (0.00 → 0.08 → 0.80 → 2.10 → 4.24 → 6.21 → 7.23) — actual value lags target by design (lerp smoothing in Hero.jsx). Pin release verified: at scrollY 2849 the sticky top became -599 and the 'Wyróżniają nas kompetencje i rzetelność.' Wartości heading became visible. Hero elements present with all required data-testids and Polish copy ('Infrastruktura IT stworzona dla ciągłości Twojego biznesu', 'Zaplanuj konsultację', 'Poznaj usługi'). No regressions: cookie banner appears on first load and can be dismissed; all 7 navbar links visible & clickable (Wartości scrolls to y=3058); /netapp and /privacy routes both return 200 and render; PL/EN language switcher toggles hero title to 'IT infrastructure built for the continuity of your business'. No JS page errors; only benign 404s for missing static assets (unrelated to pin & scrub).
critical_code_review_comments: Benign: 5 static-asset 404s observed during navigation to /netapp and /privacy — likely missing images/fonts. Not related to Hero pin & scrub. Main agent may want to audit static asset references.

Note: The Hero video scrub uses lerp smoothing, so video.currentTime lags the target proportional value by up to ~1.7s during rapid scroll — this is intentional for smoothness. Any future test that asserts exact proportionality should either disable lerp or use a large tolerance / wait for lerp to settle.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pin & Scrub fix is DEFINITIVELY confirmed at viewport 1440x900. .sc-app { overflow-x: clip } in App.css is the correct fix — overflow-x: hidden previously promoted overflow-y to auto and broke position:sticky. Measured pin range end = scrollerHeight(3150) - innerHeight(900) = 2250. At any scrollY within [0, 2250], .sc-hero-sticky rect.top === 0. Video duration 8.042s. Wartości section reachable via nav or by scrolling past 2250 (~2800+). All data-testids intact: hero-section, hero-video, hero-title, hero-subtitle, hero-cta-primary, hero-cta-secondary.
rca of the issue: Root cause: <main class='sc-app'> had `overflow-x: hidden` which per the CSS spec forces `overflow-y` from `visible` to `auto`, turning the element into a scroll container. When a scroll container is an ancestor of a `position: sticky` element, the sticky element sticks to that ancestor (which doesn't scroll) instead of the viewport, so it never pins. Fix: change `overflow-x: hidden` to `overflow-x: clip` (`clip` does NOT promote the other axis to `auto`), restoring the viewport as the sticky containing block. Verified by rect.top === 0 at all scroll positions in [0, 2250].
